about: What changed in Busy, newest first. build.py makes the What's new page (updates.html) and the RSS feed (feed.xml) from it. Add each release here when it goes out.

updates.title: Puzzles in their room, and every screen in your language
items: Play the puzzles in their room: on each game, tap In the room for a real wooden board in the Puzzle Parlour.
Every place opens with a short film, and follows the seasons: spring, summer, autumn and winter.
Rooms that follow your own work: boxes on the stock shelves, unpaid invoices in the pigeonholes, a leaf on the trellis for every skill, and a drawer label that glows before a document expires.
Every screen now speaks your language, Olaf, Ivy and Juno included.

updates.title: Busy speaks your language
items: Busy now speaks Dutch, German, Spanish, Italian and Brazilian Portuguese as well as English.
Local rules for each country: the right currency and VAT rates, invoices and reminders in six languages, and letters that name your country's law.

updates.title: Your guide is alive
items: Rivet, Pim and Tuck now stand in the room on your home screen, and turn their head to follow you.
The rooms follow the clock: in the morning, by day or in the evening, with the light to match.

updates.title: A guide who says what needs you
items: Your guide says one line on the home screen about what needs you most, like the last day to cancel a contract or an overdue invoice.
The rooms look better, with proper objects: the van, the counter, the glasshouse door, the jar of wins.

updates.title: Every app has its own place
items: Each app opens in its own place: the Workshop, the Glasshouse, Tuck's house and the Puzzle Parlour.
Every tool has its own room, and the top bar jumps straight to any other tool.

updates.title: Busy as free apps for Mac and Windows
items: Busy Business, Busy Growth, Busy Home and Busy Games as free apps for Mac and Windows, one for each part of your life.
Your files stay in your own folder as plain files. No account, nothing sent to us.
